codes.title: Acute pyelonephritis
evidence_quotes: homa 39.1, rigors, R flank pain, CVA tenderness marked.
codes.reasoning: The patient's clinical picture progressed from a lower UTI to acute pyelonephritis, evidenced by severe systemic and upper tract symptoms including fever (39.1), right flank pain, and marked costovertebral angle (CVA) tenderness. Per GDL-007, the presence of fever, flank pain, or CVA tenderness indicates the infection has ascended to the kidney and should be coded as pyelonephritis representing the end state of the episode.
